SQLite is not evidence for native locking or MySQL retry classes.
permanent_regressions.removed_test: Replaced isolated coordinator echo/call-count synchronization test with real composition regressions; isolated API fixtures retain only their narrow permission reference locker.

coverage_limits: Native retry classes were issued by MySQL SIGNAL with a nontransactional MyISAM witness; no physical deadlock cycle or elapsed lock-timeout claim.

menu_apis/role_menus membership is never written by SyncPermissions, so no fabricated failure at such a write; all relation projections are checked. Actual role_permissions mutation/failure is covered through own prior direct propagation.
Existing optional after-commit Runner hooks retain R6 tests; production external cache wiring is not claimed.
Native lock-order/current-candidate race covers this bounded batch; not proof for all possible C6/S3 graphs or a global lock framework.
Main specs synced only for verified prerequisites; F2 delta not synchronized or archived by this apply.
